reader_question: What local material is outside Git in this checkout, and how much belongs in the overview?
evidence_status: Illustrative populated cases, not observations of ignored files on the laptop.
relationships: Every local entry belongs to one checkout, not to every checkout of the repository.
Ignored and untracked are separate Git states.
Git state alone does not establish backup coverage.
Simple actions operate on a repository; local-file navigation selects a checkout.

alternatives.a: Counts in the repository list, explicit link to detail.
alternatives.b: Folder names and sizes directly below their checkout.
alternatives.c: A dedicated local-files screen with text filters and grouped rows.
